svg.text: WHAT THE DFT TRANSFORMS: THE PATCH AS ONE TILE OF A PERIODIC PLANE
full strength: the patch; faded: the tiles the DFT assumes
orange: c4's 200 meets the next tile's c0 at 40,
a second step of −160 the patch does not contain
green dashed: r4 meets r0 — the same row, no jump
left ≠ right puts a line through DC along kc;
top ≠ bottom puts one along kr: the cross
multiply by a Hann window: the borders go to 0
reflect first: the jump becomes a kink; = DCT
periodic + smooth: tile the first, carry the mismatch in the second
padding with 0 adds a jump to black at the new border
